GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2025-03-11T09:22:31Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Schedule Action set once to Inverter and retained
Description: Was wondering about the Scheduled Actions specifically for charging actions say 23.30-05.30 in my example where I want to guarantee an overnight charge no matter what.   Is it possible to have this set once to the inverter without it being reset?  So, in the case Solis Agile Manager webserver has an outage (host failure for example) I can be sure an overnight charge will always happen.

I had a look at setting this directly at the Inverter using the secondary or third charging periods (leaving the first period free for Solis Agile Manager to utilise) but this causes a time overlap conflict if the Solis Agile Manager tries to apply charging periods it sees a cheap periods.

Thanks for the amazing work on this project and will buy you coffees for such brilliant and simple to use solution.
